messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Wave B preview kicks off tomorrow. Need a 5-min alignment: enrollment counts, enablement slots, feedback cadence, and any renewal flags. @Devin @Sam?
Devin: Enrollment update: 12 seats confirmed, 3 waitlisted. Two customers flagged for infra asks (FinArc: SAML + HSM, NovaPay: private subnet).
Sam: For enablement we can do 2 office hours (Mon/Tue). I'll create invites. Also recommend using onboarding prompt set v3 for the first-run eval.
Maya: Copy. Risk note — FinArc mentioned renewal pressure; if they don’t see throughput improvements in 2 weeks we should escalate to AE/CSM.
Jordan: Quick perf note from infra tests: quantized-v1 on dedicated reduces median latency ~18% but we saw a small uptick in date hallucinations on edge cases. I can write up short caveats.
Devin: Can we standardize the feedback capture? Suggest a 3-question pulse + optional recording upload. I'll include a checkbox for severity (low/med/high).
Maya: Paste template (super short):
```
1) What primary job did Redwood help you do today?
2) Any pain/blocks you hit? (attach snippet or steps)
3) How likely to recommend (1-5)?
Optional: upload example prompt + output or short recording.
Severity tag: [low|medium|high]
```
Maya: Also: ask for specific sample logs/snippets when they report quality regressions — makes triage faster.
deploybot: deploybot: Dedicated pool #42 allocated to preview-b for 48h — tracking id dp-8921.
Sam: Thanks. Action question: who owns renewal-risk outreach for FinArc? @Devin can you take owner and do a 1:1 in 3 days?
Devin: I’ll own it. Will draft outreach and include usage snapshots from the console. Also will set an alert for token spike/dropoffs to catch unexpected behavior.
Maya: I'll capture these actions in the cohort doc and create a dedicated Slack channel per customer threads for feedback. Can someone confirm office hours times or I’ll default to 10am PT?
Sarah: I can host Mon 10am PT and record. +1 for Tue 2pm PT as backup.
Maya: :thumbsup: Locked: Mon 10am PT (recorded) & Tue 2pm PT. Action items summary: Devin — outreach + survey; Sam — calendar invites + office hours doc; Jordan — short eval notes + quant caveats; Sarah — host & record. Check-in Friday to review first-week signals.
Devin: Draft outreach + pulse template uploaded to cohort doc (link: https://redwood.example.com/cohorts/preview-b). Please review and flag edits.
Maya: Thanks team — I'll follow up with the cohort doc link in #customer-success after invites go out.
Sam: One more: let's add a small opt-in telemetry consent checkbox in the signup flow for this preview so we can capture usage snippets. Devin, can you add that to outreach?
Devin: Yep, will include consent language in outreach.
Maya: Great. End.
